posts.text:
Google puts Gemini 4 Argon in the API at $2 per million input tokens
https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini-4-argon-live/

Anthropic says new defences cut distillation of Claude reasoning 10-fold

Anthropic says reasoning tokens extractable from Claude fell 10 to 100 times after new classifiers and account limits, and it names Zhipu's GLM-5.3 as a distillation target.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-distillation-defenses/

Anthropic's Jack Clark moves his full-RSI forecast up to 2027

Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark writes that full recursive self-improvement is now more likely to become possible in 2027, a year earlier than he thought, because AI is showing creativity.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-clark-rsi-2027/

Builders turn Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 into a fast Mac transcriber

An independent team reused the audio encoder in Google's embedding model and trained only a small reader on 8 H100s, reaching about 5 percent word error rate on a base MacBook Air.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-eg2-speech-to-text/

Apple's $149 HomePod mini 2 ships on 30 October without Siri AI

Apple's new speaker has an S10 chip and a light-up top, but its Siri AI assistant is only promised for a later software update, while the $299 HomeView display gets it from launch.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-homepod-mini-2-siri-ai/

Apple's HomeView smart display puts Siri AI on a square 7-inch screen

Apple says its $299 HomeView, with an A18 chip and a 12-megapixel Center Stage camera, uses face and voice recognition to switch between family members.

https://theaipost.net/story/c53a6bb0a/

Character.AI files for bankruptcy, with Disney bidding $20 million for assets

The chatbot startup says its platform will be wound down if no bid keeps it running, and Disney is the lead bidder, TechCrunch reports.

https://theaipost.net/story/ca4e7f480/

Composo's DishwasherBench tests whether AI models can load a dishwasher

Composo says its open-source Spotless game scored GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra above a careful reference load on a 62-piece dinner-party level, from one run each.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-dishwasherbench/

Google folds its Spark agent into the main Gemini app as a Task button

Gemini's chat screen now has Chat and Task buttons above the prompt box, with Task being Google's Spark agent, 9to5Google reports, and a new Scheduled page for running jobs.

https://theaipost.net/story/c491df326/

Open-source Rust CAD tool SolidCraft ships an MCP server for agents

The MIT/Apache-2.0 app has about 1,200 GitHub stars, runs in the browser, and its CLI exposes tools that let an AI agent build and screenshot 3D parts.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-solidcraft/

Janas runs 80-billion-parameter models on a laptop by streaming experts from SSD
https://theaipost.net/story/find-janas-llm-ssd-experts/

TerminalHorizon fine-tune lifts a 27B model to 55.8 on Terminal-Bench 2.0
https://theaipost.net/story/find-terminalhorizon-27b/

Nikkei says NTT is near a deal for Anthropic's first Japan data centre

Nikkei Asia reports, citing unnamed sources, that NTT Data could spend $6.3 billion on an Osaka facility for Anthropic, with a partial opening expected by 2028.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nikkei-ntt-anthropic-osaka/

AWS puts OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol, Luna and Astra on Bedrock for five Asian regions

AWS says developers in Singapore, Jakarta, Thailand, Malaysia and Taipei can call GPT-6 models through Bedrock, where each output token uses up 10 tokens of quota.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-aws-bedrock-gpt6-asia/

Artificial Analysis launches AA-3D, with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 on top
https://theaipost.net/story/find-aa-3d-benchmark/

Cursor folds into The X Subscription, with Grok models at twice the usage

Cursor says its plans now sit inside The X Subscription, which runs from a free tier to $200 a month, and third-party models in Cursor move to API pricing.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-x-subscription-cursor/
